consent.title: Before we begin
consent.1: We ask simple questions. You only tap.
consent.2: Your answers help us suggest things you can try.
consent.3: No name and no phone number. After you agree, we count anonymous visits (not for under 18). If you turn on reminders, we keep a code for your phone. Stop any time.
ctx.time: How much free time do you have each week?
ctx.money: Can you spend money to start something?
ctx.data: Do you have internet on your phone?
joy.title: What do you do and forget the time?
joy.freq: How often do you do it?
helped.title: What do people ask YOU to help with?
result.title: Ready to taste
result.hint: Things to try, not a final answer.
result.rough: Your answers were fast or all the same, so this is rough. Try again later.
about: Cooker helps you find your talents and passions. We guide you with small steps, and reminders are coming soon, so you can reach them.
